remarks: An excellent investment opportunity to own a well-located multi-family property on the desirable Darien-Stamford border. Just minutes from the Springdale Train Station, this property offers strong rental appeal with convenient access to Springdale Train Station and shopping. (UNIT 1) The upper unit offers a large four-bedroom, three-bathroom layout with generous closet space, ideal for maximizing occupancy and rental yield. (UNIT 2) The remodeled second-floor unit features two spacious bedrooms, one smaller bedroom/TV Room and one modern bathroom. (UNIT 3) fully independent in-law/studio apartment area. Additional value-add features include a detached two-car garage and a sizable backyard, enhancing tenant appeal and long-term desirability. A rare opportunity for investors seeking a property with both immediate income potential and future upside in a prime location. Showings will occur on the following days: Thursday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday from 1pm to 5pm. They will continue at the 1pm to 5pm timeframe the following days.
